transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, mostly I’m here because I’m just really tired. But it's in a way that sleep doesn’t fix. It's like... even doing basic things, like unloading the dishwasher or trying to read for my certificate class, it can just feel like too much.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the time lately?

No, I wouldn't really say I feel sad. Um... it's not like I'm crying or feeling down in that way. I just... I mostly just feel kind of blank or drained, like I mentioned before. It's not really a sadness, just a lack of energy.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I have. Um, I've just stopped caring about the things that usually make me feel like myself. Like... I usually enjoy sketching or going to gallery openings, but I haven't wanted to do any of that. Even things like cooking, doing yoga, or just playing tennis with a friend... I just don't have the interest for it lately.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It's been about three months now. This whole quiet stretch... just the heavy fatigue and having low interest in everything... yeah, it's been going on for right around three months.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge lately?
No, not really. Um... I don't feel nervous or on edge at all. It's really just that heavy, drained feeling I mentioned. I honestly haven't even had the energy to feel anxious.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight lately?

Yeah, actually. My appetite has been... well, it's just been off lately. Sometimes I'll get to the end of the day and realize I've only had coffee and maybe a few bites of food. So, yeah, I've noticed my jeans have definitely gotten looser, even though I haven't been trying to lose weight at all.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual?

Yeah, I have. Um... on my slower days, it really feels like my body is moving through wet cement. It's just heavy. And with speaking, even answering a simple question from my husband... it can take me a weirdly long time to just get the words out.
Have you been feeling worthless or guilty about anything lately?
No, I wouldn't say that. I mean, I feel bad that I'm not doing as much around the house because I'm so tired, but... I don't feel worthless or anything like that. Just really drained.
Have you been having trouble concentrating or making decisions lately?

Yeah, definitely. It's been really frustrating. Like, I'll sit there with my planning app open on my phone, and I just can't decide what to do. I won't be able to figure out if I should work on a class assignment, pay a bill, or just start making dinner. It's like my brain just stalls, and I end up sitting there doing none of it for a while because I just can't choose.
Have you been feeling restless or fidgety, or have you noticed yourself pacing back and forth?
No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. I've mostly just been feeling really slowed down, like I mentioned before. So, no pacing or feeling restless.
Have you been feeling like you need to keep moving or have an inability to sit still?

No, not at all. It's really just like what I was saying a second ago... I don't have any urge to keep moving. If anything, I'm probably sitting still too much right now because I'm just so drained. So, no, I haven't had any trouble sitting still.
Do you ever feel sad or empty inside, even if it's not all the time?

Um, no, not really. I don't think I've been feeling sad or... empty. It's really just the lack of energy and the trouble deciding things that I mentioned before. But as far as actually feeling sad, no, I haven't really noticed that.
Do you feel like you're depressed, even if it's not something you can put your finger on?
No, I wouldn't say I feel depressed. Like I said, I'm just really tired and it's hard to get going, but it doesn't feel like a mood thing, you know? It's not depression, just... exhaustion, I guess.
Are there any activities that you still enjoy or find pleasure in?

Not really. I've kind of just stopped caring about the things that usually make me feel like myself. Like, normally I'd be sketching, going to gallery openings, cooking, doing yoga, or even just playing tennis with a friend. But right now... I just don't have the interest in any of it.
Have you been having any thoughts about hurting yourself?
No, I haven't. I mean, I know I'm completely drained and not interested in doing anything right now, but I definitely haven't had any thoughts about hurting myself or anything like that.
Do you ever feel hopeless about the future?

No, I wouldn't say hopeless. I mean, I know this is just a slump. I'm just too tired to really think about the future right now, but I don't feel like things are never going to get better. I just need to get my energy back.
Have you had difficulty getting out of bed in the morning due to feeling heavy or sluggish?

Yeah, definitely. On my slower days, it feels exactly like that... like my body is moving through wet cement. It's just really hard to get going. And it's not just moving around, either. Even answering a simple question from my spouse can take me a weirdly long time right now. Everything is just really slow.
Have you been fidgeting or having trouble staying still when you're sitting or lying down?
No, not at all. Like I said, everything is just really slow right now. I don't have the energy to fidget or move around much. I mostly just lay there.
Do you think your current condition is getting worse, staying the same, or getting better over time?

Um, I'm not really sure, honestly. I guess it's mostly just staying about the same. I haven't really noticed it getting any worse, but I'm definitely not getting better yet either. It just feels like I'm kind of stuck in this slow phase right now.
Have you been feeling like you're fidgeting or restless, even when you're trying to sit still?

Um, I think you actually just asked me something like that. But no, I haven't had any restlessness or fidgeting. Like I mentioned a minute ago, I'm mostly just moving really slow and laying there. Sitting still isn't a problem at all right now.
